I’m mapping those handler bodies and the auth/proxy startup sequence now so errors can flow to `Run` and bound addresses can be propagated before downstream components are created.

item.text: I’ve added the public SSO hook and started converting `Run` to return errors with variadic runtime options applied after parsing. The scope is broad: several named handlers aren’t the only ones that terminate, so I’m converting all `on*` handlers consistently and will address remaining `os.Exit`/`FatalError` paths before compiling.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='tool/tsh/tsh.go'
s=open(p).read()
# Rewrite command handlers mechanically: replace fatal statements with return err expressions, then set signatures.
handlers=['onPlay','onLogin','onLogout','onListNodes','onListClusters','onSSH','onBenchmark','onJoin','onSCP','onShow','onStatus','onApps','onEnvironment','onDatabaseLogin','onDatabaseLogout','onDatabaseEnv','onDatabaseConfig','onListDatabases']
# identify defined handlers available in this checkout beyond current file by names listed
import re
for name in handlers:
    pat=r'func '+name+r'\\(cf \\*CLIConf\\) \\{'
    s,n=re.subn(pat,'func '+name+'(cf *CLIConf) error {',s)
    if not n: continue
    start=s.index('func '+name+'(cf *CLIConf) error {')
    nxt=re.search(r'\\nfunc ["'^'"\\n]+\\{',s[start+1:])
    end=start+1+nxt.start()+1 if nxt else len(s)
    body=s[start:end]
    body=body.replace('utils.FatalError(err)','return err')
    body=body.replace('utils.FatalError(trace.BadParameter(\"-i flag cannot be used here\"))','return trace.BadParameter(\"-i flag cannot be used here\")')
    body=body.replace('utils.FatalError(trace.BadParameter(\"invalid identity format: %s\", cf.IdentityFormat))','return trace.BadParameter(\"invalid identity format: %s\", cf.IdentityFormat)')
    body=body.replace('utils.FatalError(fmt.Errorf(\"\\'%v\\' is not a valid session ID (must be GUID)\", cf.SessionID))','return fmt.Errorf(\"\\'%v\\' is not a valid session ID (must be GUID)\", cf.SessionID)')
    # returns bare at early void locations
    body=re.sub(r'(?m)"'^'"\\s*return\\s*"'$'"', '\\t\\treturn nil', body)
    # add nil at closing function, based on last close
    idx=body.rfind('}')
    body=body[:idx]+'\\treturn nil\\n'+body[idx:]
    # common internal handler calls needing error propagation
    for called in ['onStatus']:
        body=body.replace(called+'(cf)', 'if err := '+called+'(cf); err "'!= nil { return err }'"')
    s=s[:start]+body+s[end:]
# on apps and environment etc should compile, fix make client hook
s=s.replace('c.EnableEscapeSequences = cf.EnableEscapeSequences','c.EnableEscapeSequences = cf.EnableEscapeSequences\\n\\tc.MockSSOLogin = cf.mockSSOLogin')
s=s.replace('func refuseArgs(command string, args []string) {','func refuseArgs(command string, args []string) error {')
s=s.replace('utils.FatalError(trace.BadParameter(\"unexpected argument: %s\", arg))','return trace.BadParameter(\"unexpected argument: %s\", arg)')
# return nil helper before close
start=s.index('func refuseArgs('); end=s.index('\\n}',start)
s=s[:end]+'\\n\\treturn nil'+s[end:]
# main explicitly handles returned error
s=s.replace('\\tRun(cmdLine)\\n','\\tif err := Run(cmdLine); err "'!= nil {'"\\n\\t\\tutils.FatalError(err)\\n\\t}\\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w tool/tsh/tsh.go lib/client/api.go
go test ./tool/tsh ./lib/client ./lib/service"
